summary: Specifies Proportional Integral controller Enhanced (PIE), an active queue management scheme that fights bufferbloat, where oversized buffers cause high delay. It drops packets probabilistically to keep queueing delay low. It is experimental.

eli5.summary: If a line at a shop gets too long, everybody waits forever. PIE sometimes turns people away early so the line stays short and moves fast.
